tools.name: check_vitals
tools.description: Check a page's real Core Web Vitals: Google's Chrome UX Report field data (real users, 28-day window) plus a live Lighthouse lab run. Returns good/needs-improvement/poor ratings for LCP, INP, and CLS per Google's own published thresholds, and whether the page passes the actual ranking-signal bar. Ca

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_vitals" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
